title: Payment Terms Printed on Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program Statements
content:
Terms printed on the household's instrument statement for the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program: how charges on a checkout may be paid, the payment plan terms, and how soon a credit balance is refunded after the checkout closes.

| Usage type | Payment methods accepted | Smallest charge total on a checkout for which monthly payments are offered (USD) | Number of monthly payments in a payment plan | Calendar days after a checkout closes within which a credit balance is refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order | 200.00 | 4 | 30 |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order | 200.00 | 4 | 30 |
| Brass Instrument Usage | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order | 200.00 | 4 | 30 |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order | 200.00 | 4 | 30 |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order | 200.00 | 4 | 30 |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order | 200.00 | 4 | 30 |

## Terms explained

- The four accepted payment methods are online card, ACH bank draft, personal check and money order, under every usage type; no other method appears on the list.
- Monthly payments are offered when the charge total on one checkout is 200.00 or more. A total of exactly 200.00 is offered the plan; a total of 199.99 is not.
- A payment plan consists of 4 monthly payments.
- A credit balance is refunded within 30 calendar days after the checkout closes.

Hypothetical illustration: a checkout carrying charges that total 260.00 is offered 4 monthly payments of 65.00 each.
